Shri G.S Thakur -Government Advocate for the respondent/St
 Order

This is the first bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No./FIR No. 234 of 2024, registered at Police Station Bagsevaniya, Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2)(n), 363, 323 of IPC and also under sections 51 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned senior counsel appearing for applicant submitted that investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
He is in possession of the copy of the charge sheet.
He relied upon 164 statement in which it is stated by the prosecutrix that she has love relationship with the applicant and she does not want any action against him.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the bail application and submitted that the offence is heinous in nature and the prosecutrix is minor.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the fact that the prosecutrix age is between 17 to 18 years 2 MCRC-26384-2024 and considering her statement recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
